articles.title: From Grandpa's Workshop to Satellite Circuits: Ana Inês Inácio's Blueprint for the Future of Wireless
articles.summary: Ana Inês Inácio designs RF chips that will power next-gen radar and satellite networks. She just won the IEEE-Eta Kappa Nu Outstanding Young Professional Award for her technical breakthroughs and global leadership in building inclusive engineering communities.

articles.title: A Naked Mole Rat's Anti-Aging Shield Has Been Successfully Transferred to Mice—and It Worked
articles.summary: Scientists moved a gene from cancer-resistant naked mole rats into mice, boosting their health and extending median lifespan by 4.4%. The gene produces high molecular weight hyaluronic acid, a molecule linked to the rodents' extraordinary longevity.

articles.title: Psyche's Martian Slingshot: NASA Probe to Skim Mars at 12,333 MPH in Daring Gravity Assist
articles.summary: On May 15, NASA's Psyche spacecraft will fly within 2,800 miles of Mars, using the planet's gravity to accelerate toward the metal asteroid Psyche. The flyby doubles as a critical test of its science instruments.
